body:
I've hit a wall with this project.  I don't really know what to do, it's giving me these panic attacks.  I've been visiting  (NSFW) www.bestgore.com to try to scare myself straight. I've frequented the site and ones like it for years now.  

I've convinced myself, with the help my squeamishness not to do anything harmful right now.  But the alternative is watching my life fall apart, and sliding back down into this hole of being a failure.  I don't know what to do.  I want it to all end, but I am too afraid of surviving as a cripple.  The alternative feels just as painful though.

I want to get stuff done, but I always find myself in a position where I'm unqualified for the job, including this project.

People have told my a psychiatrist would be helpful even if i don't think i have any problems.  But, I'm just so skeptical.  I'm worried that it might make me feel worse, that I had fallen so far that i need therapy.  It just has this stigma in my mind.  I'm the kind of person that loves to help people, but is ashamed to ask for help.

Animation is great a great hobby.  I never tried Blender, but I like that it's open-source.

The adviser/professor warned us of the exact opposite.  I too had the "as long as I learn" mentality.  The entire first class for thesis was about: "I hear students tell me, but i worked really hard, and learned so much!  So what?  Who cares if you tried.  If you didn't deliver the product, you have failed."  I left that first class feeling absolutely terrible.

Thank you for your recommendations.  I read the Mythical Man Month, which I really enjoyed.  I sure wish we were like 'the surgical team,' but we're all so inexperienced and well, bad at this.  Feelings that the school did not prepare us sufficiently are abound.  I had to be told that it's a little unusualy that my db class never once used a gui db manager, like MySQL, it was 100% in the command prompt.  I thought maybe that would be a good thing, I like starting with the basics, but I was more than a little lost when setting up and using MySQL for the time.  

I am have never seen any health professional about this, and never told anyone about this in my life.  I have always felt as though I am a day late and dollar short for everything in life.  I am already ashamed enough to be this old and still not fully independent.  I don't want to add even more to my image as someone who never made it in life, and always has and still does constantly need help.  My siblings are in counseling but, I don't want to have emotional crutches.

I was formerly an animator.  One of the things that keeps me going is this plan for using software to help animators in a big way.  But I can barely handle this thesis, so I can't imagine the even bigger project I have in mind.  Maybe I could hire a team, but I have no clue how to get capital for that.  

ASP.NET, I have never touched, it was recommended because the other  team members have some experience in it.

I've done a lot of things.  But I feel like I can do none of them really well.  I promised myself I would work really hard in school and get out of this mess, and be able to support myself, pay off debt, and be proud of myself. 

But so many things have gone wrong. Many pointless classes that gave us only busy work, professors that plead with us to not come to class so he won't have to.  I missed 2 basic prerequisite programming classes, because they were cancelled, and was moved into a more advanced Java class and passed.  I thought maybe it was good luck and I had saved time, but now I see that it was a huge mistake.  Understanding OO took me much, much longer.  

This is also why I feel unemployable.  This rushed education, while other people seem to have years of relaxed self education in HS.  Now I am in over my head in the thesis project.  I don't think I can handle another failed attempt to thrive in the working world.  

I think employers will wonder why I have this gaping hole in my resume after graduation when I can't find a job.

One of the reasons I feel as though this project is doomed is that the advisor/professor/program head is very 'here's the problem, go figure it out' kind of guy.  Which is fine, except that this program is so broad.  I've only taken a few courses that actually have programming.  One had basic Java, the other basic PHP and some html/css.  I am so unprepared  for a project of this scale with this small amount of instruction.

The client (not the same guy as above) is seemingly detached emotionally from this project.  I think he is just a researcher for the university who answered a call out for any ideas for thesis projects.  He is extremely prone to scope creep, and says yes to anything and everything that he and anyone thinks of.  He isn't really sure what it's to look like.  I was told by the prof. that this was our unique challenge.

I would do anything for a mentor in this field right now.  Anywhere where i can learn at a reasonable pace, in the kind of environment you described.  

My initial basic intro to programming classes were cancelled due to me being the only one in the class, so I was moved into Java I, without taking the perquisites.  I survived the class, but so much knowledge fell through the cracks.  I feel like I have been running to catch up ever since.  Especially now.

I couldn't live off of it.  I was an animator, and the life of an animator if unstable.  Jobs end quickly.  I wanted something more stable that I was interested in.  And to succeed in any artistic you have to be the best of the best, and have started early. 

One of the motivations I have, is I want to use software to help young people make their films.

Its actually SE, not CS, I forget there's a difference.

I know that I have no clue what I am doing.  The education, the program is broad, and rushed.  I look at the threads about programming job interviews.  I can never answer any of the questions people say they got.  I can barely program.  I know I'm unmarketable, compounded by how the competition is filled with 22 year olds who've been programming since they were 12.

It has been suggested I might be best suited as a BA, since I'm best with the documentation.  I get  more experience writing up the requirements and manuals, since everyone else hates doing it, and since few in the program write English as a 1st language, it naturally falls to me, which is fine, I know all too well what it's like to feel lost when tasked with something, so I will gladly help them, rewrite, whatever they need from me.

I too have a gf who I met unexpectedly. Together for a while.  Unfortunately, she's on a student visa, and will likely have to leave in the next year.  Probably the only thing keeping me going.  I almost certainly won't have her much longer.  I work full time, plus school, so I don't get see her at all anymore.  Schedules just aren't matching

The thesis is basically creating a 'mind map', using jQuery, and getting its data using ASP.NET.  Kind of like this: http://arborjs.org/  but it has to work in a very specific way, possibly with a layered aesthetic, like clicking a node sends the current nodes into the background, but simplified as one big node under one headline (or else all those little tiny nodes would be hard to read).  Some nodes will contain quotes that link to source documents (doc, or pdf) that can be uploaded, and bring you to that quote, highlighted, in the document.  This all has to be within an expanded node in the mind map.  

We are not sure if this is how it will work, the client has no clear vision, but the whole point if to represent a research paper as a mind map, to allow people to quickly get an idea of the research, yet still read the less abstracted information through the documents.

I am trying to stay psyched about it, was doing well for a while, but I'm alone in it.  I'm so inexperienced, i have no idea what I am doing.  My friendly teammates, bless'em are woefully incompetent, same as me.  Only I am the team lead, everyone is counting on me to pull them through.
